properties.name: The "did this repair fix it?" question names the change that most likely fixed the defect, and asks about half as often
properties.rationale: Fix program item 10; Anthony, 2026-10-03: "Yes, queue it". Root cause on fact:the-overtaken-defect-question-named-the-real-fix-once-in-77-2026-10-03 (CAUSES from art:detect): attribution by nearness alone, blind to the joins the record already holds, with strictly-later dating and an any-realizer hop. Fixed at the cause and the class: which changes count (joins first, any type; same-day; nearness only through the subject or a file realizing it alone; attributed repairs excluded), how the question closes (INVALIDATES only, said in the prose; tested that INVALIDATES clears it whatever else joins it), and noise (shared files, attributed repairs, and answers that expire when the set moves). Every threshold was measured against the sweep's 77 judged rows before it was chosen: undated near repairs as questions would add 41 with 2 of 24 judged ones useful, so they are named in the evidence instead; counting new_feature near changes would raise 84 questions for one more fix seen; a file realizing more than the subject alone added 9 questions and no fix named first. WEIGHED AND NOT BUILT: closing a defect in the same call that records its fix (an `invalidates` field on add_change_event). Three of the twenty fixes listed the defect in `affected`, four joined it by CAUSES/MITIGATES — the joins are now read and the question names the exact one call, at the next detect_gaps, so a second route to the same edge would add tool surface for a case the loop now catches; revisit if a measurement shows joined fixes still left open after this ships. LIMITS, stated: four of the twenty fixes are joined to nothing and touched neither the subject nor a file realizing it; four are undated and only near; one (the latent re-probe fix) is recorded as fixing another finding too and so is named in the evidence, not offered; two are new_feature changes that are only near. Old acknowledgements carry over only where they drew GOVERNED_BY from the change (6 of the 12 on main); of the 12 acknowledged on main, five keep their exact id, six are no longer raised (their only candidate is now not offered), and one is asked again because a MITIGATES-joined change nobody judged is now offered first.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: defect_overtaken_by_change now offers, most likely first: changes JOINED to the defect (the defect CAUSES them, they MITIGATE it, or a repair's CHANGED set names it; any change_type, dated or not, because the join places them after the defect), then NEAR repairs dated on or after the defect's day — the same day included — that CHANGED its subject or a file realizing that subject alone. Never offered: a change that CAUSES the defect, one dated before it, and for NEAR a repair already recorded as fixing another finding, an undated one, one that reached the subject only through a file shared with other capabilities, or a non-repair; each of those is NAMED in the evidence. The question names INVALIDATES as the only close and says a CAUSES or MITIGATES edge is not one. An acknowledgement is remembered per change: a change already judged for a defect (both GOVERNED_BY the same accepted decision:ack) is never asked about again for it, even when the question's id moves. Measured with the binaries on main 73cf37b: 62 questions became 35; the real fix is named FIRST for 9 of the sweep's 20 fixed defects (was 1 of 20 seen at all); on #662's export the list is now identical to main's, where it had added or re-keyed 41.
